chapter: Postwar years, accident and lean times
title: Sorting out when he met Red Richards and first played Canada
summary: Wilson untangles the chronology: he met Richards in the forties and gigged with him, played Canada first with Fats in 1936 and later with the Saints and Sinners.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
